## Summary

<!-- One paragraph. What changed and why. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new user-facing capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor` — code change without behavior change
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `build` / `ci` — build or pipeline change
- [ ] `chore` — internal housekeeping
- [ ] BREAKING CHANGE

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (commitlint will check)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs updated (if behavior or contract changed)
- [ ] `NOTICE` updated (if third-party code was added)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or PII in the diff
